title: External payout processed
description: This event occurs when payout is successfully processed and an external payout account was configured during product attachment.

amount.title: Amount to be credited
amount.description: Amount to credit to the external account

type.title: Informs whether the account is internal (Pismo) or external (client's account). Value is always `EXTERNAL` for external payouts

external_account.title: External account
external_account.description: Use this field to provide the external account information configured during product attachment as key-value pairs. Pismo does not evaluate this content

external_account_id.title: External account ID
external_account_id.description: A client-provided account ID that identifies the account within your organization.

retroactive_adjustment_amount.title: Retroactive adjustment amount
retroactive_adjustment_amount.description: Represents a signed adjustment to previously capitalized interest resulting from a retroactive recalculation. This value is reported separately from amount and is never included in it. Positive values indicate additional interest due, while negative values indicate previously overstated interest. Returned only when the capitalization includes a backdated adjustment.
